hype_amount_at_queue.meaning: HYPE amount computed from the exchangeRate at queueWithdrawal time and hardcoded in the withdrawal request

hype_amount_at_confirmation.meaning: HYPE amount actually returned to the user at withdrawal confirmation

exchange_rate_at_queue.meaning: exchange rate used to compute hypeAmount at queueWithdrawal time

exchange_rate_at_confirmation.meaning: exchange rate in effect at withdrawal confirmation after rewards or slashing

rate_changed.meaning: the exchange rate differs between queueWithdrawal time and withdrawal confirmation

assumptions: The withdrawal fee is skipped and the buffer is zero or less than Alice's deposit amount (as_buffer).
The exchange rate change is caused by validator rewards or slashing between queueing and processing.
The 100->50 HYPE example is representative of the slashing magnitude.

unresolved.description: Exact exchangeRate values before and after slashing are not given beyond the 100->50 HYPE example, so the numeric relation between exchange_rate_at_queue and exchange_rate_at_confirmation cannot be fully defined.
Report does not state whether the slashing scenario was observed on-chain or is hypothetical.

limitations: Only the i_incorrect_amount impact is formalized; i_zero_hype, i_bob_revert, and i_price_relation are deferred to future claims.
The condition narrows to the slashing subcase described in the report; the general requirement covers any exchange rate change.
The relation is stated at the amount level (hype_amount_at_confirmation == hype_amount_at_queue) rather than as a rate identity, since rates cannot be defined in QEXPR.
Code-level binding of exchange_rate_at_queue and exchange_rate_at_confirmation to actual storage variables is deferred.
